title: Network Reachability
description: Given an undirected network of nodes and connections, determine whether a path exists from a specified source node to a destination node.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; 0 <= m <= 200000; nodes are numbered from 0 to n-1.
inputFormat: First line: n and m. Next m lines: two integers u and v describing an undirected connection. Final line: source and destination.
outputFormat: Print YES if the destination is reachable from the source, otherwise print NO.
hints: Start from the source and visit every unvisited neighboring node using BFS or DFS.

examples.explanation: A path exists from 0 through 1, 2 and 3 to 4.
The graph has two disconnected components.
